brief: Describes one payment to send, who is paid, how much and under which id, in the words the hub expects.
detail: Build it with its chained setters, then hand it to Pay of stzPaymentsPort. The txId is yours and unique, and a retry reuses it. The amount comes from StzAmountQ and only XOF is accepted. The payee is named by alias, by IBAN or by account, and one of WithConfirmation or WithoutConfirmation must be chosen. Building an order sends nothing: AsBody shows what would be sent.
